summary: Lobby at lobby/index.html (+ styles.css). Rooms come from window.__benchHost.params.rooms; open rooms link to #/room/<id> and open a fixed layer, so scroll survives open and Back. Coming-soon rooms are dashed, unlinked cards. Korean is the default; the EN toggle persists in localStorage mol-lang. Dark mode follows the system unless toggled. System fonts, no external requests, no raster assets. Local selfcheck: G-live fails only because the harness FLIP call cannot resolve its venv from this isolated layout (FLIP on the same frames run directly = 0.0), which zeroes craft and visual locally.
